# StableDPP

> StableDPP is a blockchain-verified Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform for fashion brands, textile manufacturers, and retailers. It helps companies issue EU ESPR 2024 (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781) compliant Digital Product Passports — tamper-evident, GS1 Digital Link-aligned records of a product's materials, origin, certifications, and sustainability data, accessed via QR code.

StableDPP is free to start, requires no technical setup, and anchors every passport to a blockchain record so sustainability claims are independently verifiable rather than merely asserted. The platform supports component-level tracking (fabric, dye, hardware, lining), an auto-validating ESPR compliance engine, instant GS1 Digital Link QR code generation, and a sustainability data dashboard. It is GDPR-compliant, with Private Data Collections and role-based access controls that let brands share verified public data while keeping supplier identities, pricing, and sourcing details confidential.

Note on terminology: EU ESPR 2024 requires Digital Product Passports to be interoperable and built on open standards (Articles 10–11) — it does not mandate blockchain specifically. StableDPP's use of blockchain is a design choice for tamper-evidence and independent verifiability, not a regulatory requirement.

## Product

- [Product Overview](https://stabledpp.com/product): Platform capabilities — blockchain anchoring, component-level DPPs, ESPR compliance engine, GS1 Digital Link QR codes, sustainability dashboard, data privacy and supplier confidentiality controls.
- [Get Started](https://stabledpp.com/get-started): Create a free StableDPP account and issue a first Digital Product Passport.
- [Book a Demo](https://stabledpp.com/book-a-demo): Book a free 30-minute personalised demo with a live Digital Product Passport built for your product.

## Solutions

- [Solutions Overview](https://stabledpp.com/solutions): DPP workflows for fashion brands, manufacturers, and retailers, plus EU ESPR 2024 compliance coverage and consulting/implementation/BaaS hosting services.
- [For Fashion Brands](https://stabledpp.com/solutions/fashion-brands): Full product DPP creation, component-level tracking, consumer-facing QR codes.
- [For Manufacturers & Textile Exporters](https://stabledpp.com/solutions/manufacturers): Component DPP issuance, fibre origin tracking, supplier verification, multi-brand data sharing.
- [For Retailers](https://stabledpp.com/solutions/retailers): DPP verification portal, real-time supplier data, EU Green Claims Directive compliance.

- [How to Create a Digital Product Passport (Step by Step)](https://stabledpp.com/blog/how-to-create-a-digital-product-passport): A five-step process from identifying products to attaching a GS1 Digital Link QR code.
- [How Much Does a Digital Product Passport Cost?](https://stabledpp.com/blog/digital-product-passport-cost): What drives DPP pricing, from free self-serve tiers to enterprise contracts.
- [Digital Product Passport for Textile Manufacturers](https://stabledpp.com/blog/digital-product-passport-for-textile-manufacturers): DPP requirements and supply-chain data preparation for textile manufacturers and exporters.
- [What Is GS1 Digital Link?](https://stabledpp.com/blog/gs1-digital-link-digital-product-passport): How the GS1 Digital Link QR standard connects products to their Digital Product Passport data.
